mapper.select: SELECT ipi1.item_id, pp1.published_on AS date_last_published, pp1.submitter_id AS submitter_id, ( SELECT pp1.schedule FROM item_publish_item ipi1 INNER JOIN publish_item pi1 ON ipi1.publish_item_id = pi1.id INNER JOIN publish_package pp1 ON pi1.package_id = pp1.id WHERE ipi1.item_id = #{id} AND pp1.target = '${liveEnvironment}' AND pp1.package_state = ${packageReadyState} AND pp1.approval_state = '${packageApprovedState}' ORDER BY pp1.submitted_on DESC LIMIT 0, 1 ) AS date_scheduled FROM item_publish_item ipi1 INNER JOIN publish_item pi1 ON ipi1.publish_item_id = pi1.id INNER JOIN publish_package pp1 ON pi1.package_id = pp1.id WHERE (pi1.publish_state & ${livePublishedState}) > 0 AND ipi1.item_id = #{id} ORDER BY pp1.published_on desc LIMIT 0, 1

SELECT ipi1.item_id, pp1.published_on AS date_last_published, pp1.submitter_id AS submitter_id, ( SELECT pp1.schedule FROM item_publish_item ipi1 INNER JOIN publish_item pi1 ON ipi1.publish_item_id = pi1.id INNER JOIN publish_package pp1 ON pi1.package_id = pp1.id WHERE ipi1.item_id = #{id} AND pp1.target = '${stagingEnvironment}' AND pp1.package_state = ${packageReadyState} AND pp1.approval_state = '${packageApprovedState}' ORDER BY pp1.submitted_on DESC LIMIT 0, 1 ) AS date_scheduled FROM item_publish_item ipi1 INNER JOIN publish_item pi1 ON ipi1.publish_item_id = pi1.id INNER JOIN publish_package pp1 ON pi1.package_id = pp1.id WHERE (pi1.publish_state & ${stagingPublishedState}) > 0 AND ipi1.item_id = #{id} ORDER BY pp1.published_on desc LIMIT 0, 1

GROUP BY i.id

mapper.update: INSERT INTO item (site_id, path, preview_url, state, locked_by, created_by, created_on, last_modified_by, last_modified_on, label, content_type_id, system_type, mime_type, locale_code, translation_source_id, size, parent_id, ignored, saved_as_draft) SELECT s.id, #{newPath} AS path, IF(i.system_type = '${systemTypeFolder}', NULL, #{previewUrl}) AS preview_url, CASE WHEN i.system_type = '${systemTypeFolder}' THEN 0 ELSE ${state} END, null, ${userId}, NOW(), ${userId}, NOW(), IFNULL(#{label}, i.label) AS label, i.content_type_id, i.system_type, i.mime_type, i.locale_code, i.translation_source_id, i.size, #{parentId}, i.ignored, i.saved_as_draft FROM item i INNER JOIN site s ON i.site_id = s.id WHERE s.site_id = #{siteId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND i.path = #{previousPath}

UPDATE item_target it INNER JOIN item i ON i.id = it.item_id INNER JOIN site s ON s.id = i.site_id
SET it.previous_path = IF(it.previous_path = #{newPath}, NULL, IFNULL(it.previous_path, #{previousPath})) WHERE s.site_id = #{siteId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND i.path = #{newPath}

#{type}
SELECT i.path FROM item i WHERE i.site_id = #{siteId} AND i.ignored = 0 AND (i.state & #{states}) > 0

SELECT i.path, i.system_type AS meta_system_type, i.label AS meta_label, i.mime_type AS meta_mime_type FROM item i INNER JOIN site s ON i.site_id = s.id WHERE s.site_id = #{siteId} AND ( (i.system_type IN ('page', 'component') AND i.content_type_id = #{contentType}) OR (i.system_type = 'script' AND i.path = #{scriptPath}) )

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM item i INNER JOIN site s ON i.site_id = s.id WHERE s.site_id = #{siteId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND i.ignored = 0 AND i.system_type <> 'folder'
AND i.path RLIKE(#{path})
AND (i.state & #{statesBitMap}) > 0

WHERE s.site_id = #{siteId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND i.ignored = 0 AND i.system_type <> 'folder'
AND i.path RLIKE(#{path})
AND (i.state & #{statesBitMap}) > 0
GROUP BY i.id

mapper.update:
UPDATE item i INNER JOIN site s ON i.site_id = s.id SET i.state = (i.state | #{onStatesBitMap}) & ~#{offStatesBitMap} WHERE s.site_id = #{siteId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND i.ignored = 0
AND i.path RLIKE(#{path})
AND (i.state & #{statesBitMap}) > 0
AND i.system_type <> '${systemTypeFolder}'

UPDATE item, (SELECT child.id AS childId, (SELECT i.id FROM item i INNER JOIN site s on s.id = i.site_id WHERE s.site_id = #{siteId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND i.path = concat(#{path}, '/index.xml')) AS newParentId FROM item child INNER JOIN item parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id INNER JOIN site s ON s.id = child.site_id WHERE s.site_id = #{siteId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND parent.path = #{path} ) AS updates SET item.parent_id = updates.newParentId WHERE item.id = updates.childId
mapper.select: SELECT i.path FROM item i WHERE i.site_id = #{siteId} AND (i.path LIKE CONCAT(TRIM(TRAILING '/index.xml' from #{path}), '/%') OR i.path LIKE CONCAT(TRIM(TRAILING '/' from #{path}), '/%') ) AND i.system_type <> 'folder' AND i.ignored = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE item SET path = REPLACE(path, #{previousPath}, #{newPath}), locked_by = NULL, state = CASE WHEN system_type = '${systemTypeFolder}' THEN 0 ELSE (state | #{onStatesBitMap}) & ~#{offStatesBitMap} END WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND (path = #{previousPath} OR path LIKE CONCAT(#{previousPath}, '/%'));

UPDATE item SET preview_url = #{previewUrl}, state = (state | #{onStatesBitMap}) & ~#{offStatesBitMap}, last_modified_by = #{lastModifiedBy}, last_modified_on = #{lastModifiedOn}, label = #{label}, content_type_id = #{contentTypeId}, system_type = #{systemType}, mime_type = #{mimeType}, size = #{size}, locked_by = NULL, ignored = #{ignored}, saved_as_draft = #{savedAsDraft} WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND path = #{path};

UPDATE item SET path = CASE WHEN path = #{sourcePath} THEN #{targetPath} WHEN path LIKE CONCAT(TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM #{sourcePath}), '/%') THEN CONCAT(#{targetPath}, TRIM(LEADING #{sourcePath} FROM path)) ELSE path END, state = (state & ~${systemProcessingState}) WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND system_type = 'folder' AND path LIKE CONCAT(TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM #{sourcePath}), '/%');
